summary: Kurimoto Co., Ltd. focuses on high-quality, short-lead-time, and low-cost manufacturing solutions for the semiconductor industry. They offer a range of processes including metal and resin 3D printing, machining, and CT scanning, aimed at producing high-functionality parts tailored for high-mix, low-volume production.
